body: Add the final mirror-mode timing invariant: audio semantic endpoints and Stage slide-applied events originate on different devices, so session readiness must establish a monotonic device-to-session clock mapping with measured uncertainty. Fusion must bind to an immutable slide occurrence, never processing-time `currentSlide`. A finalized utterance is eligible only when one slide occurrence covers the full expanded interval `[audioStart - uncertainty, audioEnd + uncertainty]`. A boundary crossing, missing/discontinuous mapping after reconnect, or uncertainty above the preregistered maximum yields `AMBIGUOUS` and abstains. Persist audio interval, slide-occurrence ID, mapping version, uncertainty, and verdict for deterministic replay.
summary: Add bounded cross-device timing fusion gate
